Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this high-scoring match. Yet again it will be a quick turnaround and after a break of one day, Pakistan will cross swords with Australia in the decider on Saturday, 2nd April 2022. The action will begin at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT), but you can tune in early for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Babar Azam, the winning skipper of Pakistan, is also the Player of the Match! Says that they planned to play positive and form partnerships. Calls the stand between Imam and Fakhar outstanding. Admits that they could have bowled well but they gave away too many runs in the middle overs. Wants to improve on this aspect in the next ODI. He is very proud to get a hundred in front of his home fans. States that they believed that they can chase this down. Reminds that they didn't chase it down in the last match and he is pleased that they crossed the line this evening.

Aaron Finch, the captain of Australia, says that the opening stand for Pakistan set the foundation and Babar also played an unbelievable knock. Tells that 348 is a good total but probably it was not for today. Mentions that it was a beautiful one-day wicket. Adds that they bowled well and he feels that when Pakistan took the risk while batting, it paid off for them which can happen in ODI cricket with only four fielders allowed outside the ring.

Imam-ul-Haq (106) comes up for a quick chat. The Pakistan opener says this he knows his game and just follows the process. Tells that he has worked hard for this and thanks the Almighty and his parents. Feels that it is all about self-belief and they knew they could chase it down. Mentions that they were lucky in this match. Adds that there's always room for improvement and says that in white-ball cricket if one gets set then the runs come easily. Says that everyone knows about his and Babar's friendship and they know each other's weaknesses and strengths and they have played a lot of cricket together. Tells that they really needed that win for the team. Further adds that Australia are a very good batting and fielding side so they wanted to come out on the right side of the result this evening. Ends by saying that they want to win on Saturday and will be working towards that.
Stay tuned for all the interviews...

Early in the evening, Australia improved their batting from the last match. The loopholes that were visible in the first ODI were plugged although there is still some room for improvement as far as their batting in the last 10 overs is concerned. Anyway, the intent shown by the young guns, Travis Head and Ben McDermott, was incredible, especially in the middle overs and that propelled Australia to a big total. After losing the plot in the initial phase of Powerplay 3, they recovered through the impressive hitting from Marcus Stoinis and Sean Abbott, and that handed the Aussies a score close to 350 but in the end, even that proved to be inadequate.

Australia didn't do a lot wrong with their bowling efforts. Imam was dropped on 25 by Ben McDermott but that honestly was a very tough chance. After that, it was majorly a chanceless knock from all the Pakistan batters. You can just say that the Aussie bowlers were countered with discipline and positive intent from the home team. Pakistan's top four premier batters contributed to the cause with Imam and Babar getting to their hundreds. Khushdil's knock when it got close can be counted as yet another positive.

Chasing a mammoth target, the Pakistan openers camped in and built a great platform. Both Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq were slow to get off the blocks but soon found the rhythm and never allowed the required rate to climb up during their century partnership. A magical delivery from Marcus Stoinis provided Australia with the first breakthrough but that was followed by yet another century stand - between Imam and Babar Azam. The best part of Pakistan's chase was they were always near the required rate, and not even once did it climb to 8 or beyond till the 46th over. Things got close due to the fall of Rizwan's wicket and some fine death bowling by the Aussies but eventually, Khushdil's cameo took them home.

A nervy finish for the home team but they have crossed the line, much to the delight of the Lahore crowd. A well-planned chase from Pakistan! It was a mountain of a target in front of them but they conquered it, in the end, to register their highest successful chase in ODIs! Babar Azam had planned the same in the first ODI also and took a lot of criticism but he showed this evening that his decision to bowl first in the first ODI wasn't the wrong one, it's just that they lacked in the execution part. The series is now back to level terms with all to play for on Saturday!

FOUR! Iftikhar Ahmed finishes things off in style! What a chase from Pakistan - their best in ODIs! Also, their first win against Australia in ODIs since 2017 to end the 10-match losing streak. Full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed clears his front leg and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Pakistan win by 6 wickets!
Scores level! Full and on off, Khushdil Shah makes room and pushes it to mid on for a single.

SIX! Wonderful stuff! In the slot outside off, Khushdil Shah stands tall and launches it with disdain over long on for a biggie. A 101-metre hit! This is some batting from the power-hitter. Just 2 required now!
FOUR! Easily done! A freebie from Nathan Ellis. Serves a full toss, outside off and Khushdil Shah sticks his bat out and slaps it over covers for a boundary.
Length ball, leg-lined. Iftikhar Ahmed helps it on its way to fine leg but there is a fielder there. Will only get a single.
Slower ball, full and outside off, Iftikhar Ahmed drives it through covers for a couple of runs. 13 needed off 11!
A good yorker, on leg, Khushdil Shah jams it down. 15 needed from 12 balls!
Very full, tailing back in on off, Iftikhar Ahmed squeezes it out off the inner half of the bat to fine leg for a single.
Full and on off, Khushdil Shah pushes it to long off for a single now.

SIX! Pakistan are in cruise control now! This time pace on from Sean Abbott and it has gone miles over. Back of a length, outside off. Khushdil Shah swings across the line and powerfully hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That made a cracking sound as it left the blade.

FOUR! This is why Khushdil Shah has been promoted up the order. A pressure-releasing shot! Length ball, outside off. Khushdil Shah waits for it and tonks it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A good slower ball from Abbott, outside off. Khushdil Shah looks to smack it to the leg side but misses it altogether. Little tension is building in the Pakistan camp.
Change in bowling. This game is getting close all of a sudden. Sean Abbott is back to bowl at the death.
Touch fuller, outside off. Khushdil Shah drives it to extra cover. Aaron Finch there misfields but quickly collects it back. The batters are happy with the single. 27 needed off 18 balls!
Slower ball, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed knocks it down to long on for a run.
Length ball, leg-lined. Khushdil Shah misses his clip and gets hit on the pads. The batters take a leg bye. Mild appeal from Nathan Ellis for an lbw but nothing from the umpire.
Back of a length, outside off. Khushdil Shah dabs it to backward point. The game is still Pakistan's but Australia are doing well to put pressure with these dots.
Slower ball from 'round the wicket, on off. Khushdil Shah blocks it back onto the turf.
Length ball, angling in on leg, Iftikhar Ahmed tucks it to long leg and crosses ends.
A single to end! Floats it up, on middle. Iftikhar Ahmed drives it to long off and keeps the strike. 31 needed from 24 balls!
Iftikhar Ahmed walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Is there another twist left in the tale? Mohammad Rizwan goes downtown but holes out. Tossed up well outside off, Mohammad Rizwan has to reach out for that one. He shimmies down and throws the kitchen sink at it. Mistimes his aerial shot to long off where Sean Abbott takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Abbott b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Slower delivery, on leg. Khushdil Shah pushes it to long on and rotates the strike.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Rizwan leans forward and works it to deep square leg for a run.
Fires it full and outside off, Khushdil Shah fails to jam it down. The ball goes off the keeper's pads to the leg side and the batters take runs off byes.
Loopy ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan works it to long on for an easy single.

Full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it back and Nathan Ellis falls in his followthrough. He tries to stop it with his right boot but ends up deflecting it towards the umpire standing at the bowler's end. It hits Ahsan Raza on the legs and goes towards mid on. The batters take a single. 36 needed from 30 balls!
Length ball, on off. Khushdil Shah pulls it to mid on for a tight single.
Back of a length, pushed wider of off. Khushdil Shah chases it and chops it off the under edge back to the keeper.
Length ball from 'round the wicket, on middle. Khushdil Shah whips it to deep mid-wicket. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it easily in the end.
Khushdil Shah has been promoted up the order. 40 needed off 34 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! A big celebration from Australia! They still believe that they can do it. Nathan Ellis gets his man. Fuller in length, on off, perhaps a cutter. Babar Azam looks to hammer it down the ground but it takes the inner half and flies to short mid-wicket. Marnus Labuschagne there takes a sharp catch over his head. Babar Azam walks off receiving a huge round of applause. End of an excellent knock from the skipper. Can Australia capitalize?
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Nathan Ellis

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length, on off. Babar Azam covers the line and punches it back to the bowler.
A full toss, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan hits it straight back to Zampa.
Floats it up, on middle. Azam tucks it to square leg and crosses ends. Everything is looking very comfortable for Pakistan at the moment.
Two again! A low full toss down the leg side and Babar Azam paddles it past the keeper to fine leg for another brace.
Another two! Full and outside off, Babar Azam creams it to deep cover for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan drives it through covers for a single.
Shortish, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan paddles it to fine leg and gets two easily.
Adam Zampa is back on. This is the last throw of the dice from Finch.

Fuller in length, on leg. Babar Azam bunts it in front of long on. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably. The running between the wickets has been excellent. Babar Azam is keen to finish this chase quickly now. 48 needed from 42 balls.
FOUR! Shot of the highest quality! Length ball, on off. Babar Azam makes room and crunches it through covers. Times it to perfection and gets a boundary.
Slower ball again, on off. Mohammad Rizwan glances it to square leg for a run.
Touch fuller, on middle. Babar Azam drills it to long on and crosses ends.
Full and on the pads, Mohammad Rizwan moves across and flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower ball, on off. Babar Azam whips it to wide of long on for a run.
Length ball, on middle. Punched to long on for a run. 58 needed from 48 balls.
This is pushed to mid on for a single.

Babar Azam can celebrate now! CENTURY! Take a bow, Babar Azam! This has been a standout knock from the skipper! One of the best knocks from him. Back of a length, outside off. Babar Azam stands up on his toes and dabs it behind point for a single. He lets out a roar. Gets a big round of applause from his teammates and his fans. Mohammad Rizwan gives him a warm hug as well. His 15th ODI century!
A full toss, outside off. Babar Azam stands tall and pushes it through covers. A little bit of comedy there as Babar Azam roars thinking he got to his hundred but needs to calm down. Moves to 99!
Full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it to deep point and gives the strike back to Babar Azam.
Good-length ball, on middle. Babar Azam knocks it to mid on for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan stays deep and cuts it. Beats backward point and gets two runs. 65 needed from 54 balls.
Back of a length, on off. Azam punches it along the ground to long on for a single. He moves to 96!
Short, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan hops and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Mohammad Rizwan gets across and under-edges it back onto the deck.
On a length, on off. Babar Azam punches it to mid off for a quick single.
Good-length ball, on leg. Babar Azam misses his tuck. He gets hit on the pads and Sean Abbott puts in a loud appeal for an lbw but the umpire says no. Australia do not opt for the review.
End of Powerplay 2! 5 fielders are now allowed outside the inner circle till the end of the match.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, Babar reaches out and drives it to deep cover for a run. 70 needed off 60 balls.
Fractionally short and on off, Babar punches off the back foot but finds point. No mistake this time.
Misfield! Green pitches it up and around off, Babar strokes it to point where the fielder fumbles and they get two.
Short and on the leg side, pulled to long leg for a single.
Delivers it full and outside off, Rizwan drives it square of the wicket on the off side and picks up a couple of runs.
Bowls it short and around off to start his spell. Rizwan steers it straight to point.
Cameron Green is back on as well.
On the pads, worked behind square leg for two.
Width on offer outside off, again on the shorter side, Rizwan cracks it to sweeper cover for a run.
Short again, around off, climbing onto the batter, Rizwan mistimes his pull shot to mid-wicket.

Misfield from Finch. Around off, on a length, Babar pushes it off the inner half to mid-wicket. Aaron allows it through and they cross. Moves to 89, this is now the highest individual score by a Pakistan skipper against Australia in ODIs, informs the on-air commentator. 79 needed off 69 balls.
FOUR! Babar wants to finish the chase quickly! Abbott bangs it in short, around off, Azam stands tall inside the crease and clubs it wide of mid on for a boundary. Moves to 88!
FOUR! Pristine timing! Back of a length, around middle and leg, Babar stands there, picks it off his pads and flicks it with sublime timing to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Sean Abbott is brought back into the attack.
Quicker one, full and around leg, pushed down to long on for a run. Pakistan are cruising at the moment. 88 needed off 72 balls.
FOUR! You just can't drop short to this batter, he will punish you every time. Babar goes back inside the crease and powers his pull shot over mid-wicket.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it in the gap at covers for one.
Extra flight, a full toss on middle, it's knocked down to long on for a run.
Quicker and fuller around off, pushed defensively back to the bowler.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full and down the leg side, Babar kneels and sweeps it wide of short fine leg for an easy boundary.
Wrong 'un around off, Babar punches it to deep cover for a run. Under 100 needed now. Pakistan continue to have the upper hand!

FOUR! Delightful shot! Brilliant batting from Babar. Zampa gives this one some extra flight but lands it too full outside off. Babar lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover and fetches the second boundary of the over. 100 needed off 79 balls.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for one.
A googly around off, Azam doesn't pick it but still plays it nicely through covers for a single.

FOUR! Smashed away! Zampa tries to bowl the quicker one but drops it short on middle and leg, Babar immediately drops his weight on the back leg and plays a smashing pull shot for a boundary at deep mid-wicket.
Nicely tossed up around off, fuller in length, Rizwan goes down low and sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Slightly quicker through the air, flat and short around off, Babar defends it near the front pad.
Tossed up, around off and turning away, Rizwan stretches forward and drives it past the bowler to long off for a run.
Fuller and around leg, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Another googly around off, Babar cuts it without much timing to point.
Googly, around off, on the shorter side, Babar picks it up, goes deep inside the crease and hammers it to sweeper cover. The fielder makes a sliding stop and saves two.
Drops it short and on off, Rizwan goes back and pushes it with the turn to long off for a single.
Flatter and on middle, nudged in front of square on the leg side for one. Top over from Zampa! 116 needed off 90 balls.
Fuller and a bit quicker through the air, around off, Rizwan shapes up for the sweep shot but then defends it back.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Top edge but safe! Loopy again, full and on off, Babar top-edges his sweep shot behind the keeper. It falls safely and they get two.
Loopy and full around middle, Babar defends it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Rizwan walks out to bat at No.4.

OUT! Imam holes out and Adam Zampa claps in delight! This is a very big breakthrough for Australia. End of a remarkable knock and the 111-run stand. Once again Imam tries to find the boundary on the first ball but miscues his shot. Too full and around off, Imam is down the track for a big shot down the ground but gets more height than distance. Marnus Labuschagne moves across to his right from long on and takes the catch safely. 120 needed off 95 balls and Australia have an opening now.
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Adam Zampa is back on.

SAFE! Swepson delivers a slider, around middle and leg and it skids on with the angle. Babar stays back to work it around but misses. He is hit on the pads as the ball rolls behind. They appeal unsuccessfully for an lbw. Alex Carey doesn't collect the ball cleanly but then picks it up to break the stumps. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The replays find Babar's back leg grounded.

Appeal for an lbw and then stumping... Babar Azam was hit on the pads and Mitchell Swepson appeals for an lbw but that was sliding down leg. Alex Carey then whips the bails off and a stumping appeal is referred upstairs. Replay shows that Babar Azam has his feet grounded. NOT OUT!
FOUR! Great skills from Babar! He picks the length in a trice, it's short and hammered over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker one, flatter and around leg, Imam steps back and hits it to covers for one.

Appeal for an lbw, the umpire shakes his head. Full and around off, spinning in with extra bounce, Imam tries to reverse sweep but misses. He is hit on the right arm, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Australia decide not to review.
Extra loop on this delivery, full and on off, Babar caresses it through covers for a run. FIFTY FOR BABAR, off 42 balls. This is his 19th ODI fifty and the crowd applauds.
Slightly short and on off, Babar moves back and forces it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Imam goes aerial and lofts a full ball over covers. The long off fielder cuts it off and they get a couple. 128 needed off 102 balls.
Fuller again, on off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
CENTURY STAND! Off 83 balls. Flighted delivery, full and outside off, Imam leans and strokes it through covers for a brace.
Fullish and around leg, Babar walks forward and drives it to deepish mid off for a single.
Loopy and full, on middle, Babar tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes safely to mid off.
Full and flighted, around off, Imam sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks! Pakistan continue to march on. Imam-ul-Haq has got his century and is looking rock solid. He is getting good support from Babar Azam who is approaching his half century as well. Pakistan have done nothing wrong so far and are well on course to get a record chase. Australia are still in search of wickets and they need them soon otherwise this game will be done for them. Travis Head to bowl after the break.
Fuller and on middle, Babar leans forward and defends it down. A good over from Swepson.

HUNDRED FOR IMAM! He is having a wonderful ODI series and what a comeback this is from him! Flighted and around off, full around off, Imam uses his feet and eases it down to long on for a single. The crowd is making a lot of noise. Imam thanks the Almighty and does a 'Sajda'. Last time he missed out but this evening, he would love to finish the chase.
Short and on middle, Babar gets back and punches it down to long on for one.
Loopy and full, landing close to off, Imam pushes it softly to the right of the cover fielder for a run. Moves to 99!
Two dots. Fuller and around leg, driven back to the bowler. Swepson collected the ball and had a shy at the striker's end.
Flighted delivery, full and around leg, Imam walks forward and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Mitchell Swepson (4-0-23-0) comes back on.
Abbott digs it in short once more, down the leg side, Imam tries to pull but ends up gloving it down to fine leg. Takes a single and moves to 98.
Short again, around off, this time Babar pulls and sends it to deep square leg for a run.
Fractionally short and on off, Babar punches it off the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
Off pace, short and outside off, Azam chases and pushes it from the toe end of his bat to point.
Moves to 97! A touch short and on off, Imam chops it down to third man and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Great start to the over. Short in length, around leg, Imam turns inside the crease and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.

SIX! Off the top edge but Pakistan won't mind! Flighted delivery, on off. Babar Azam sits low and brings out the slog sweep. The ball goes off the top edge but still flies over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 144 needed off 120 balls.
Once again Imam-ul-Haq uses his feet and takes it on the full. Drives it to long off for a run this time.
Imam-ul-Haq gets to the pitch of the ball and drills it along to extra cover. The ball rolls to the deep and the batters take two.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Babar Azam makes room and drives it to long off for yet another easy single.
Quicker and full, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq gives the charge and drills it along the carpet to long off for a run.
Flighted delivery, on middle. Pushed to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Babar Azam stands tall and punches it to deep cover. He keeps the strike.

FOUR! What a stroke! On a good length, on middle. Nothing wrong with the delivery, Babar Azam just stays on the front foot after his trigger movement and smacks it to deep mid-wicket for a sweet boundary.

On a good length, on off. Imam-ul-Haq slashes it hard to deep point. He pushes hard for the second run and even sets off but there was never a second run there. Babar Azam sends him back and rightly so. Pakistan won't want a run out at this stage.
Nicely bowled! Sean Abbott sees Imam-ul-Haq coming down the track and bangs it short, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq sways away from the line.
Length ball, on middle, Babar Azam gets behind the line and bunts it to mid on. This time calls for a quick single and gets it easily.
Good length, on middle. Babar Azam prods and keeps it out to mid on.
Sean Abbott (4-0-31-0) returns into the attack.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Babar Azam drives it nicely through covers for another single.
Full again, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq clears his front leg and works it to long on for a run.
Full and on the pads, swept straight to short fine leg.
Full and on middle, Babar Azam drills it down to long off for a run.
In the slot, on off. Imam-ul-Haq gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
Short, on off. Babar Azam rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover for one.
Now Nathan Ellis pulls his length back, on middle. Babar Azam knocks it to long on and retains the strike with a single. 14 from the over!

FOUR! Glorious batting! Length ball, on middle. Babar Azam opens the full face of the bat and flicks it through wide mid on. Sends it racing along all the way to the rope. Pakistan have been very impressive in this run chase so far.
Full and outside off this time, Babar Azam gets forward and drives it through covers. Gets two!
FOUR! Sensational shot! Fuller, on the pads. Babar Azam clears his front leg and flicks it uppishly to deep mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Full and slanting it on leg, Imam-ul-Haq flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length, on off. Imam-ul-Haq gets behind the line and punches it straight down the ground to long on for a brace. The 50-run stand comes up between these two!
A googly, on off. Imam-ul-Haq rocks back and pulls it to long on. The ball drops well short of the fielder and the batters take a single.
Short and on off. Babar Azam goes back and cuts it to deep point for an easy single.
Full and on middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Imam-ul-Haq loves to go inside out! Makes room for himself and lofts it inside-out over extra cover. Finds the gap and gets a boundary. Lovely batting!
Loopy ball, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it to short fine leg.
Full and on middle, whipped to wide of long on for a single.
On the pads and it is turned to mid-wicket. At the halfway mark, Pakistan are 159/1. 190 needed off 150 balls.
Length ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq taps it to point.
Length ball, on leg. Babar Azam clips it off the pads to deep square leg for one.

Good length, on off. Babar Azam pushes it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The ball shoots up and goes over the backup fielder. The batters take advantage of this and steal another single as overthrows.
Full and on off to Babar from over the wicket, nudged to mid-wicket.
Length ball from 'round the wicket, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Short, outside off. Babar Azam chops it straight to cover.
Quicker and full, on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq clears his front leg and drags his flick off the toe end of the bat to square leg for a run.
FOUR! Edgy! A googly, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq dances down and looks to launch it over mid off. The ball goes off the outside edge and races away to the third man fence.
Short and on off, Babar Azam makes room and cuts it to sweeper cover. He crosses ends. 150 comes up for Pakistan!
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq skips down the wicket and works it to long on for a run.
Floats it up, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq rocks back and knocks it on the leg side.
Change in bowling. Adam Zampa replaces Mitchell Swepson from this end.
On a good length, angling in on middle. Babar Azam nudges it to short mid-wicket.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq comes down the track and heaves it to long on. Didn't quite time it well but will get a single.
Length ball, on leg. Babar Azam clips it to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Short of a length, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, leg-lined. Imam-ul-Haq tickles it to fine leg. The fielder there runs across and cuts it off. Keeps it down to two.
Good-length ball, on off. Babar Azam steers it to backward point for a single.
Nathan Ellis comes back into the attack. His two overs have gone for 10 runs.

Just looped over the bowler! Loopy ball, on middle - a googly. Imam-ul-Haq gets back to work it on the leg side but ends up chipping it just over Mitchell Swepson off the leading edge. The batters take a couple!
Floats it up, on middle. Babar Azam stays deep and punches it to long on for one.
Half-tracker, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single this time.
Short, on off. Imam-ul-Haq punches it back to the bowler.

SIX! Imam-ul-Haq is playing a fabulous knock! In the slot from Mitchell Swepson, outside off, fuller in length. Imam-ul-Haq goes down on one knee and goes bang. Plays a slog sweep and the ball goes all the way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Babar Azam steps out and takes the ball on full. He flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Touch fuller, on off. Babar Azam pushes it to mid off for a single.
On middle and leg, Babar Azam gets behind the line and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball again, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it to covers for a quick single. Marnus Labuschagne has a shy at the bowler's end but Imam-ul-Haq makes it in time with a dive.
Good-length ball, on off. Imam-ul-Haq covers the line and knocks it to the left of the bowler.
Good comeback from Stoinis! On a good length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq tries to cut it away but gets beaten.
FOUR! Shot of the day! Imam-ul-Haq, you beauty! Length ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq uses his feet and lofts it over extra cover for a glorious boundary. Almost went the distance.
Nothing happening at the moment. The play is halted, the reason is unknown to us.
Short, on off. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it to deep cover and keeps the strike with a single.
Slider, on off. Babar Azam knocks it down to long on for a single.

On the pads again, Imam-ul-Haq uses his feet and pushes it down the ground to long on for a single. He brings up his fifty. Another half century for him and he is playing a good knock. He will look to convert this into a three-digit score.
Flatter and quicker, on the pads. Babar Azam turns it to square leg for a run.
Shortish, on off. Babar Azam punches it to covers.
Tossed up, on middle. Babar Azam blocks it from the crease.
Full, on off. Babar Azam drives it to mid off for a quick single. Off the mark straightaway!
Babar Azam walks in next at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Marcus Stoinis gets his man and the breakthrough for Australia! A much-need breakthrough for Australia this! An off-cutter from Marcus Stoinis, on a good length, Fakhar Zaman with no feet movement plays down the wrong line. The ball goes past his blade and shatters the stumps. Marcus Stoinis lets out a massive roar. A huge moment in the game. Big wicket for Australia and Fakhar Zaman has to depart after a fine knock. That one landed and gripped to take the top of off. 231 needed off 187 balls.
FOUR! Races away like a bullet! A full toss again, outside off. Fakhar Zaman thrashes it to wide long on for a boundary. Poor delivery and Stoinis gets punished.
A low full toss, on off, Imam-ul-Haq drags it to long on and jogs to the other end.
On a length, on off. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it to mid-wicket by going on his toes.
Good-length ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman knocks it softly to sweeper cover and crosses ends.
Flighted delivery, wide outside off. Imam-ul-Haq reaches out and looks to cut but nearly chops it back onto the stumps.
This is worked to sweeper cover for a run.
Drops it short, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq rocks back but couldn't quite get hold of his pull. A single to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drills it to cover-point.
Full and quick, on leg. Fakhar Zaman clears his front leg and smashes it just over Marnus Labuschagne at mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Fakhar Zaman makes room and drives it to mid off.

Drinks! Pakistan are moving along nicely and the openers have done a good job so far. Australia desperately need a breakthrough here and need their bowlers to step up. Meanwhile, Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq will look to continue the good work.
Lands it on a length, close to off, Fakhar stays back and steers it to deep point for a run.
Fine leg comes up. Long on drops back.
Stoinis gets away there. Short and outside off, Fakhar stays back and tries to run it down fine but finds short third man.
FOUR! Nicely adjusted! Fakhar Zaman uses his feet to take it on the full and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary. 241 needed off 200 balls.
Another length ball is angling in from around off, Imam gets back and pushes it past the running short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Fuller and on off, angling in, Fakhar knocks it down to long on for a run.
Starts with a short ball outside off, Imam cuts it behind point and shouts for two. Some hesitation after that and they get only one.
Marcus Stoinis to operate now.
Around leg, Fakhar tries to flick but it takes the leading half of his blade and rolls to mid-wicket. A good start from Swepson.
Flatter one, short and on middle, Imam goes back and punches it to long on for a run.
Short again, outside ff, Imam cracks it to sweeper cover. Stoinis makes a fine stop in the deep and saves two. 100 comes up for Pakistan!
Short and outside off, cut to point.
Oohhh...that nearly went onto the stumps. Quicker one, short and around leg, Imam fails to flick and is hit on the inside of his back thigh. It drops near the leg stump and stops there.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Imam tries flicking but misses.
Starts with a flatter delivery, short and around off, Fakhar works it through square leg for a run.
Mitchell Swepson is brought into the attack now.
Short and on off, slapped to deep cover for one. 10 from the over and Pakistan are doing well to keep the required rate under check. 253 needed off 210 balls.
Leans forward to a full ball and helps it to mid-wicket.
Advances down the track to whip it across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It ricochets to covers.
Drags his length short and bowls it wide outside off, cut through point for a couple.
SIX! Fakhar goes big and sends it over the rope. Fifty for Zaman! Floated delivery, full and around off, Fakhar dances down the track and dismisses it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Very full and on off, stroked down to long off for a single.
Floated delivery, full and wide outside off, Zaman drives it down the ground but finds mid off.
Flight this time, full and on off, Imam knocks it down to long on for a run.
SIX! Imam has sent it a mile! Zampa drops it short and on middle, Imam goes deep inside the crease and pulls it aerially over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slower through the air, full and on off, another drive from Imam but he finds the cover fielder.
Imam lunges to a full ball around off and defends it towards covers.
Quicker through the air, short and outside off, Fakhar taps it down wide of backward point for a single.

Short and outside off, Imam chops it down through point and Green gives the chase from short third man. He stops it in the deep with a slide and they get two. 9 from the over, 271 needed off 222 balls.
FOUR! Much better from Imam! Full and flighted, around off, Imam sits down on one knee and powers it towards wide long on for a boundary.
Aerial but safe! Tossed up, full and on off, Fakhar slogs it against the spin and it goes in the air. Doesn't carry to Stoinis at deep mid-wicket who collects the ball on one bounce. A single.
Fuller again, around off, this time Imam drives it through covers for one.
Fires in a full ball around leg, Imam tries to flick but gets a leading edge to covers. Looks for a run but is sent back.
Delivers it short and outside off, it's cut through the gap at cover-point for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Imam cuts but finds the point fielder. Eventful over.
Ben McDermott has hurt himself on the fingers while attempting that catch and is going off the field.

DROPPED! Too full in length, around middle, Imam walks forward and whips it across the line. It's aerial and Ben McDermott jumps at short mid-wicket. He extends his right hand but fails to catch it. The ball deflects behind and they take a couple. Ben seems to have hurt his fingers there.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Zaman gets back and works it through square leg for a run.
Quicker through the air, full and around leg, Fakhar tries to flick but misses. It goes on the leg side off his pads.

Shout for an lbw, the umpire shakes his head. Loopy again, full and around leg, turning down, Fakhar tries to sweep but misses. He is hit on the back leg, they appeal but the umpire doesn't agree. Finch is convinced and takes the DRS. The UltraEdge finds no bat. Over to the Ball Tracking and it shows that the ball had landed outside leg. Australia lose a review.
Loopy and full, landing on middle, Fakhar defends it back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends then! Adam Zampa is introduced into the attack now.
Too full and around leg, Imam clips it off his pads but finds short fine leg. Tidy start from Head.
Tossed up, around off, Head drives but finds the cover fielder.
Full again, around off, Fakhar strokes it past the bowler to long off for one.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through covers for a couple.
Loopy and on off, helped to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
End of Powerplay 1! 4 fielders now can be stationed outside the inner ring till the 40th over. A bowling change for Australia as well. Time for some spin as Travis Head comes into the attack.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Zaman helps it wide of mid-wicket and jogs across to the other end. At the end of Powerplay 1, Pakistan are 63/0. Australia were 65/1 at this stage.
Around leg, on a length, Zaman flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Well timed and the misfield helped! Too full and around off, Fakhar drives it crisply down the ground. The mid off fielder dives but fails to stop and it races behind for a boundary.
Too full and landing around middle, Imam hits it down towards mid on and scampers across to the other end.
Fuller and close to off, Imam is on the front foot as he defends it back.
Pushes a full ball to covers and looks for a run. Zaman is sent back as the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end. 12 from the over and this end continues to leak runs.
On off, a length delivery, Fakhar plays it down to covers.
FOUR! Nicely played! Width there outside off, a touch short, Fakhar plays late and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! That's a poor delivery after the fielder moved from that direction. Fuller and outside off, Fakhar Zaman leans into the drive and thumps it through covers for a boundary. 50 up!
Good comeback from Green. Nails his yorker on middle, Zaman cannot do much and just digs it out to covers.
FOUR! Tonk! Short in length, close to off and angling in, Fakhar clears his front leg and muscles it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Cameron Green comes back into the attack. He gets a change of ends.
Slower one, on a length around off, Imam stays back, delays his shot a bit and works it wide of mid on for a couple of runs. 4 from the over, a good start from Nathan Ellis.
Fuller and on off, driven down to mid off and Fakhar took a quick run.
Around middle and off, on a length, once again Fakhar stays on the back foot and then defends it back.
A yorker around off, Fakhar hangs deep inside the crease and digs it out to covers.
Delivers it on a length and around middle, Imam flicks it through square leg and rotates the strike.
Ellis begins his spell by digging it short, around middle and there is some extra bounce as well, Imam fends it away on the leg side and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Nathan Ellis is brought into the attack now. He replaces Cameron Green.
Slower one, on a length around middle, Imam tickles it wide of short fine leg and gets a single.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Imam tries to flick it fine but misses. A good take by Carey.
Spearing yorker on middle, just a hint of swing, Imam flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Walks down the track and tucks a length ball in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
A low dipping full toss on off, Fakhar tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the back pad. It deflects in the gap at covers and they cross.
On a length and around off, slower in pace, Fakhar plays it down to point and Marnus Labuschagne has an immediate shy at the bowler's end.
FOUR! This is clever batting. Short in length, around off, Fakhar steps back to give himself room and steers it past backward point for a boundary. Abbott has proved to be costly so far.
Three dots to end the over. Full and around off, Imam pushes it down off the inner half to mid on. Tidy over by Green.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Lands it on a length and around off, Imam taps it down to point and looks for a run. Fakhar is then sent back as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, Imam glances it wide of short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Full and outside off, Fakhar drives it wide of extra cover and scampers across to the other end.
Angling in from around off, Fakhar Zaman works it towards mid-wicket and is disappointed with himself.
Gently turns a length ball in the gap at mid-wicket and shows good urgency to come back for the second run. 11 from the over.
A length delivery on off, the batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Around off, on a length, Imam drives it to covers.
Short and around leg, Fakhar helps it to short fine leg where Zampa misfields and they get three runs.

SIX! FAKHAR IS SAFE! The heel is touching the advertising cushion. Fakhar survives and the crowd roars. A touch short in length, around off, Zaman latches onto it and powers it over the leg side. Marcus Stoinis is manning the deep square leg region, he jumps to catch it over his head. He then realizes that his weight is pushing him beyond the fence. So, Stoinis releases the ball, goes back and jumps in to take the catch again. The umpire though consults upstairs and the replays clearly show that it's not taken cleanly. A maximum is signalled.
Is that caught cleanly? The answer is no.
Fractionally short on off, Fakhar punches it from the middle of the bat but finds covers.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to mid off. It's been a sedate start from Pakistan in this big run-chase.
Slants in a length ball on off, from 'round the wicket, Imam stays on the back foot and defends it down.
FOUR! Edgy! Back of a length, outside off, Imam stands back to cut it over point but it flies off the top edge and goes over short third man for a boundary. Not sure that was deliberate or not.
Full in length and outside off, pushed with soft hands to wide mid off for a run.
Swing and a miss! Fakhar is feeling the pressure. Sees the width outside off and goes after it. Fails to connect though.
Mistimed again by Zaman. Short and on off, Fakhar goes on the back foot but punches it from the bottom half of his blade. It goes straight to covers.
Back of a length on middle, Imam goes on the back foot and glances it behind square leg for two. The crowd has found its voice after this 9-run over.

SIX! Imam has dispatched this one. Pakistan will hope that this shot breaks the shackles. Sean Abbott serves it on a length around middle, Imam dances down the track and towers it over long on for a maximum.
Fuller and around off, Zaman drives it towards extra cover and immediately sets off for a single.
Pitches it on a length, around middle and off, Fakhar covers the line and defends it back on the pitch.
Around middle, on a length, turned to mid-wicket.
Struggling with timing! Short and on off, Fakhar again chops his attempted shot off the back foot, this time to covers.
Beaten on the drive! Lands it on a length and in the channel outside off, Imam leans forward to drive but gets beaten by the away movement.
Movement off the pitch, from a good length around middle and leg, Fakhar inside-edges his attempted flick. It rolls wide of short fine leg for a run.
Short and on off, Fakhar stays back and chops it down towards backward point.
Fullish and around off, shaping in a bit, Imam drives it down the ground and the mid off fielder moves across to his left to make a partial stop. A single is taken.
Green pulls his length back and delivers it on top of off, Imam goes on his toes and plays it down to point.
A little bit of swing in the air for Green. He serves a full toss on off, Imam drives it down to mid off.
Cameron Green will bowl from the other end.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Fakhar keeps his weight on the back foot and pushes it out to covers. Fine first over from Sean Abbott!
Back of a length, around off, Fakhar defends it down from the back foot to the off side.

Slightly short and around off, Imam leans forward and crunches his drive to cover-point. Mitchell Swepson dives across to his right to stop the racing ball. He gets up and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. They cross now for a run.
A touch full and on off, Zaman drives it to mid off and gets off the mark with a single. The chase is also underway.
Baten, this time! Sean Abbott repeats the last delivery but from the off stump line, Fakhar Zaman feels for it inside the line and gets beaten.
Sean Abbott begins with a gentle length delivery, in the channel outside off and angling away, Fakhar Zaman allows it through to the keeper.
